summary: Verify and consolidate 3 pending API dependency upgrades

delivery.outcome: Publish the verified uvicorn 0.53.0, PyJWT 2.15.0 and jsonschema 4.26.0 updates requested by Codot PRs 12, 13 and 14.
nonGoals: Add dependencies or change application behavior
Change workflow, publication actors or required checks

architecture.decision: Consolidate three existing dependency version pins under one native interfaces ticket; retain hosted API and governance gates and validate actual JWT/schema/ASGI bindings locally on both Python versions.
architecture.rollback: Revert the three version pins to the accepted base versions.

validation.evidence: All ten existing API tests pass on Python 3.10 and 3.12 with the combined updates; actual JWT valid/expired/wrong-signature, inline schema valid/invalid and uvicorn ASGI loading smoke checks pass.
Native governance, both hosted API matrix checks and both hosted governance checks pass before independent exact-head protected publication.
